label.none_selected: None selected — select bookmarks (Ctrl+Click) or a folder first
label.capnotice: This run will process only {{cap}} of {{total}} bookmarks (AI session cap).
label.nofolder: No bookmarks found in this folder — select bookmarks or a folder first

hint.profile: Optional: prefer tags from a learned profile's vocabulary
hint.consider_existing: The AI may reuse tags you already use instead of inventing new ones

error.noconfig: No AI configuration found. Go to Bookmarks > AI Settings to set up your API key first.
error.notable: Error: could not access bookmark table.
error.noselected: No bookmarks are selected. Select bookmarks first (Ctrl+Click or Shift+Click).
error.notags_content: No bookmarks have accepted tags. Toggle tags or use Accept All first.

progress.quota_minute: The per-minute API limit was reached. Retrying in {{wait}}s (attempt {{attempt}} of {{max}}). You can leave this window open — it will continue on its own.
progress.quota_daily: The free daily quota has been exhausted. It resets at midnight Pacific Time (in about {{hours}}h {{minutes}}m). You can close this window with peace of mind — nothing has been changed and no bookmarks have been lost.
progress.quota_stopped: The run was stopped because the API quota is still exhausted after several retries. This is very likely the daily limit — it resets at midnight Pacific Time (in about {{hours}}h {{minutes}}m). You can close this window with peace of mind — nothing has been changed and no bookmarks have been lost.

summary.processed: Processed {{total}} bookmarks. {{accepted}} have suggested tags ({{tags}} total tags).
summary.quota_box: ⚠ The run was stopped by the API quota. Only {{processed}} of {{total}} bookmarks were processed — the remaining {{left}} were NOT processed and keep their current tags. The quota resets at midnight Pacific Time (in about {{hours}}h {{minutes}}m). You can close this window — nothing else has been changed.

status.scanned: Run complete — review the suggested tags below.
status.applied: Tags applied to the server ({{count}} bookmarks).
